Where you live and where you love.
Where you work, drive and travel.
Places are just states of mind.
How you got there is part of the story.
OUR TOWN & COUNTRY –
THE STORY OF US
For every road traveled, it’s as if it was paved just for you. Because an
idea or design is never as original as the route taken by
original people like you. To see and perceive, feel and hope in only
the way that you can and the way that you do.
It is beauty in the eye of the beholder.
AN ORIGINAL
BEHOLD YOU:
Design your life and we’ll get you there.
What it takes to make great design from the inside out. It’s not what your car says about
you, it’s what goes into your choice of one. It’s how you build your home, family and the passions you
pursue. You decide your life and style and your vehicle should never claim to speak on your behalf. At
Chrysler, we know that when we do our best — when we make a vehicle that is strong and safe, versatile and
innovative, responsive and reliable, beautiful and luxurious to the touch and to the eye — that it complements you.
And becomes part of your story.

AN INSIDE ATTITUDE. A monotone Black interior, unique to the Town & Country S, starts with Black Torino leather-trimmed seats with Silver stitching and
embroidered “S” logo, and Black Ballistic cloth seat inserts. Piano Gloss Black appliqués are found on the instrument panel and the spokes of the Black leather-wrapped
steering wheel, and the Chrysler wing design on the steering wheel matches the Black background of the exterior badging. Finishing interior touches include a Black
headliner and upper consoles, Black center console and an “S” logo in the instrument panel cluster. A premium Super Console provides power outlets, cup holders,
covered storage, and more to both front- and second-row passengers. A class-exclusive7 dual Blu-rayTM/DVD system with HDMI input and two USB ports for recharging
is standard on S. This system allows backseat passengers to view standard DVDs and Blu-ray videos or to play a high-definition video game system on the screens.
Wireless headphones allow backseat passengers to enjoy this state-of-the-art system without forcing front-seat passengers to hear the accompanying audio.

FUEL ECONOMY
THESE ARE THE DAYS. Special occasions can be found in the simple things when it’s your day-in-the-life routine. That’s why
Town & Country provides a host of standard comfort, convenience, power and styling features that set the tone for the lineup.
Starting with the LX base model, the packed standard-equipment features include leather-trimmed interior and seating,
Uconnect® touchscreen radio with ParkView® Rear Back-Up Camera,6 three-zone HVAC, Stow N Place® Roof Rack, power sliding
doors and liftgate, Stow ’n Go® seating and storage system, steering-wheel audio and cruise controls, sunscreen glass, power
locks, power second-row windows, power third-row vents, six stereo speakers and 17-inch aluminum wheels. The Touring model
then adds a single-DVD player, automatic temperature control, Electronic Vehicle Information Center (EVIC), fog lamps and
automatic headlamps, power eight-way driver’s seat and the added luster of chrome bodyside molding for a dressed-up attitude.
CONFIDENCE BOOSTER. Since getting everyone there confidently is the only option, you’ll know why it matters to have a vehicle
this powerful. Powered by the standard 3.6L Pentastar® V6 engine with Variable Valve Timing (VVT), this award-winning engine boasts
best-in-class7 283 horsepower and 260 lb-ft of torque, yet efficiently provides up to 25 highway mpg,* combining an exceptional
blend of high torque, fuel efficiency, low emissions and quiet operation. The Chrysler Town & Country also features a class-exclusive7
Fuel Economizer feature that alters transmission shift patterns to help improve fuel efficiency with the touch of a button.
*2014 EPA estimated 17 city/25 hwy mpg with 3.6L engine and 6-speed automatic transmission.
